definition: Popov-Chang syndrome (POPCHAS; OMIM #618428) is an autosomal dominant neurodevelopmental disorder caused by heterozygous mutations in the YWHAZ gene and characterized by global developmental delay apparent from infancy, variable intellectual impairment, and dysmorphic features.

source.title: Popov-Chang Syndrome (POPCHAS)
source.quote: Popov-Chang syndrome (POPCHAS) is an autosomal dominant neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by global developmental delay apparent from infancy.
